messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: RW-INFER-ATL-THROUGHPUT_HIGH - SEV2 - symptoms: sustained 95th percentile token latency > 2s for embeddings in us-east-1. page: https://pd.example/INC12345

Jess: acked. I'm oncall for infra this window, taking ownership. starting with quick health checks and autoscaler status.

Omar: grabbing traces and ETA on whether this is a gradual spike or sudden. I see a burst of concurrent embed requests from customer org: org-omega.

Priya: checking model pool. Canary VM group reporting increased CPU steal on a subset of gpus-quant nodes. KV cache hit rate dropped from 88% -> 42% around the same time.

Kai: fwiw, autoscaler shows pending pods waiting for provisioning (~3m). Could be a quota/slow node spin-up issue. Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending` to confirm.

Jess: results from checks:
```
kubectl get hpa -n inference
NAME        REFERENCE           TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
embed-hpa   Deployment/embedder 95%/80%   2         20        9
```
Found 3 Pending pods due to image pull delay in us-east-1 zone-a.

Mira: can we temporarily divert traffic to eu-west-1 cluster? We have capacity there and customers should be routed transparently by gateway policy.

Priya: gateway supports region-failover; I can flip policy to prefer eu-west-1 for embed route. Will do a canary redirect for 10% first.

Omar: logs showing repeated `OOMKilled` events on a worker shard around 15:02:14 UTC. Suspect one unstable node staged cascade.

Jess: mitigation plan:
1) Move 10% embed traffic to eu-west-1 (Priya)
2) Drain and reprovision the stuck nodes in us-east-1 (Kai)
3) Temporarily bump embed-hpa maxpods from 20 -> 30 (Jess)
4) Monitor latency, KV cache warm-up, and customer impact pages (Mira)

Priya: started canary reroute at 15:05:30 UTC - `curl -X PATCH https://gateway/api/routes/embed -d '{"preferred_regions":["eu-west-1"],"canary_pct":10}'` (internal change id: cfg-7821).

Mira: support pinged legal & customer success for org-omega and added a note to status page: "We are investigating intermittent embedding latency in us-east-1; mitigation in progress." (support ticket TK-7891).

Kai: draining two problematic nodes now and forcing fresh allocations: `kubectl drain node/us-east-1a-041 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then `node replace` workflow kicked.

Jess: bumped HPA max to 30 at 15:07:10 UTC. We'll revert after stability.

Omar: after reroute and node reprovisioning, KV cache hit rate climbed back to ~80% and 95th p90 dropped to 580ms for canary traffic in eu-west. us-east lag improving.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: PD update: alert status changed to acknowledged by Jess at 15:08:02 UTC.

Priya: monitoring full roll for latency across both regions. No errors in model outputs, only higher tail latency.

Mira: customer-impact assessment: org-omega reported slight delays in embedding generation for non-critical background jobs; no data loss. CS updated customers on estimated mitigation timeline ~15-20m.

Jess: status ping @15:15 UTC: load is settling, autoscaler stabilized at 12 replicas, KV warming continuing. keeping the canary 10% for 10 more minutes, then incrementally shift back once us-east nodes fully healthy.

Omar: collecting diagnostic bundle for postmortem (logs, k8s events, node metrics). Saving to s3://rw-ops/incidents/INC12345/diag-15-17.tar.gz

oncall-bot: Reminder: add oncall timeline to the incident timeline doc - /docs/incidents/INC12345/timeline.md

Priya: at 15:23 UTC increased canary to 30% while verifying no regression. Latency stable.

Jess: at 15:30 UTC rolling back canary to original routing (all traffic back to normal) after us-east-1 nodes passed health checks. Observed 95th latency <= 600ms across the board.

Mira: support message to org-omega: "We observed elevated latency earlier due to a node provisioning issue in us-east-1. We've mitigated the impact by routing and reprovisioning nodes; normal performance has resumed. Follow-up postmortem forthcoming."

Jess: closing notes: suspected root cause = slow node image pull + cascading OOM on a shard -> autoscaler lag. Action items:
- Kai to file infra bug for image registry caching in us-east-1 and add pre-warming to the node boot script (assigned).
- Omar & Priya to include KV cache warmup steps in the embed runbook and add a canary routing play.
- Mira to draft customer-facing postmortem and timeline.

Kai: filed infra ticket INF-4053 with mitigation steps.

pagerbot: :tada: Resolved: incident marked resolved by Jess at 15:33:55 UTC.

Jess: dropping final ack. Will run the RCA meeting at 10am PT tomorrow. Thanks everyone for the fast sync. :heart:
